passages.quote:
This guidance applies to the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) in England and Wales.

It has been prepared to assist administering authorities and asset pool companies in the LGPS in England and Wales to comply with the requirements of the Local Government Pension Scheme (Amendment) (Governance) Regulations 2026.

It covers requirements in the following areas:

knowledge and understanding

LGPS senior officer

Independent Person

Independent Governance Reviews

It is published alongside:

Local Government Pension Scheme: guidance on preparing and maintaining an Investment Strategy Statement

Local Government Pension Scheme: guidance on asset pooling
